description: Image Description: The image features a close-up of a wooden baseball bat positioned vertically on the right side of the frame. The bat has engraved text that reads "GENUINE MIO RAMON SANTIAGO DETROIT TIGERS" in vertical alignment along its surface. The wood shows signs of use, with visible grain patterns and some blue markings or stains near the top. To the left of the bat, there is a dark-colored baseball helmet, partially visible, with a glossy finish.
